name: Oblation Husk, Mass
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 3, shaman 3

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as oblation husk except as noted above and the bonus maximum for the temporary hit points increases to 15.
